title: coord.py digest labels a two-item intent state=done when only one of its items is done
goal: coord.py digest gives an intent that names several items (item=A,B) the state of the item the digest was asked for, or one state per item, so a done progress for A after the intent does not show state=done on the line read for B, which is still live. Found by the SP-fp3hxl6q review (S4, BG-kalkmokl/BG-caynvdnv residue).

run:
import os,sys,tempfile,types
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import coord
D=tempfile.mkdtemp();st=os.path.join(D,'c.sqlite');t=[1000.0];clock=lambda:t[0]
A=lambda **k:types.SimpleNamespace(store=st,**k)
def post(kind,**f):
    t[0]+=1;return coord.run(A(command='post',kind=kind,field=[f'{a}={b}' for a,b in f.items()]),clock)[0]
coord.run(A(command='claim',key='session/s1',ttl=21600,holder='s1',budget=None),clock)
post('intent',session='s1',item='BG-aaaaaaaa,BG-bbbbbbbb');post('progress',item='BG-aaaaaaaa',state='done')
d=repr(coord.run(A(command='digest',key=['BG-bbbbbbbb'],lines=10),clock)[0]);print(d)
sys.exit(0 if 'BG-bbbbbbbb' in d and 'state=done' not in d else 1)
